owner_todos.title: Create the @AIGraphicTV YouTube channel
owner_todos.why: The pipeline needs a real channel to publish to.
owner_todos.how: Create a YouTube channel named AI Graphic TV, handle @AIGraphicTV if available.

owner_todos.title: Add the channel ID to research/config.json
owner_todos.why: The research bot needs this to track our own channel's stats and exclude us from competitor scans.
owner_todos.how: Once the channel exists: YouTube Studio -> Settings -> Channel -> Advanced settings -> copy the Channel ID, paste it into research/config.json -> own_channel.

owner_todos.title: Add a YT_API_KEY repo secret
owner_todos.why: GitHub Actions (research/stats workflows) needs a YouTube Data API key to read public video stats.
owner_todos.how: Create an API key in Google Cloud Console with YouTube Data API v3 enabled, then add it as a repository secret named YT_API_KEY (Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions).

owner_todos.title: Confirm this repo is public and GitHub Pages is on
owner_todos.why: GitHub Pages (the dashboard) only serves for free on a public repo.
owner_todos.how: Settings -> General -> Danger Zone -> check visibility is Public. Then Settings -> Pages -> Source: Deploy from a branch -> main -> /docs.
